access.notes: Standard polytypic structure: space group P6₃mc (No.186), lattice constants a=3.08 Å, c=10.05 Å. Atomic positions: Si at (0,0,0) and (2/3,1/3,1/2); C at (0,0,0.375) and (2/3,1/3,0.875) for the four inequivalent sites. Publicly documented in many sources (e.g., ICSD #60314).
Standard group‑theory reference. Available in textbooks such as 'Properties of the Thirty‑Two Point Groups' by Koster et al.
